title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-06-19 05:25:39 最新章节：第362章 久别重逢
content_zh:
深夜，一山村，一片寂静。
咕！
咕！
偶尔有一两声鸟叫，还带着虫子出没发出的吱吱声。
不多时。
村尾靠近后山的一个小木屋点燃了微弱的油灯。
小木屋中床上斜躺着一个少年，少年穿着一身破烂又满身都是补丁的破麻衣。
少年刚刚睡醒，额头上脸上满是虚汗，像做了一场大梦。
少年名叫邹阿大，村子里的人都叫他阿大。
近两年，因为少年总是一有时间就是一个人独自发呆，但双眼有神又像在沉思，村里有长辈上前开导，总是听到一些莫名其妙的话，比如现代科技，穿越来修炼界该如何如何的话，村里很多人都认为阿大在说梦话，也有人认为阿大有精神病，时间长了，大家都叫他追梦。
追梦的养父养母得知，反而觉得追梦这个名字好，比阿大这两个字好听多了，也就跟着村里人叫追梦。
咚、咚、敲门声打断了追梦的思绪，随后房门被推开，同时传来养父养母的关心声。
梦儿怎么了？又做噩梦了？
追梦看去，眼前是一对年过半百的夫妻，说话的正是满脸关心的妇人。
一听梦儿两个字，就知道是叫女孩子的，自己好端端的男孩，被叫成梦儿，追梦一时没有回应。
夫妇两人也没有观察到梦儿此时神情的不对。
追梦定了定神，脑子里搜索一阵，才想到自己穿越了，在穿越过程中遇到异常时空逆转规则，自己的身体变成了婴儿样，并且记忆自我封印起来，自己被眼前夫妇已经养育了12年，追梦连忙说道。
“没！
没事！
我在床上坐一会就好了”

追梦说着，身上还有点不自在，接着关心的道“这么晚了，养父养母，你们年龄大了，身体重要，早点睡吧！”
“真没事？”
一声养父养母让追梦的养父邹铁牛产生了一丝疑问。
夫妇两人收养追梦一事，在村子里并没有隐瞒，追梦也知道。
在平时，追梦都是直接叫他们父亲母亲的，看出了追梦的异常才问道。
如果是之前的追梦，肯定会拉着两老好好说说，说出他梦见到的科学中飞机，大炮，高楼大厦，梦见自己进入大阵获得修炼传承的话。
但现在的追梦却会关心的说道：“真的！
content_en:
Late at night, a mountain village was silent.
Gu!
Gu!
Occasionally there is a bird call or two, accompanied by the squeaking sounds of insects.
Not long after.
A weak oil lamp was lit in a small wooden house at the end of the village near the back mountain.
There was a young man lying on the bed in the cabin. The young man was wearing tattered linen clothes with patches all over his body.
The young man had just woken up, his forehead and face were covered with sweat, as if he had had a big dream.
The boy's name was Zou Ada, and everyone in the village called him Ada.
In the past two years, because the boy was always alone and dazed when he had time, but his eyes were bright and like he was meditating, elders in the village came forward to enlighten him, and he always heard some inexplicable words, such as modern technology and how to travel to the world of cultivation. Many people in the village thought that Ah Da was talking in his sleep, and some people thought that Ah Da was mentally ill. As time went by, everyone called him Chasing Dreams.
When Zhui Meng's adoptive parents learned about it, they thought the name Zhui Meng was a good name, much nicer than the word "Ada", so they called him Zhui Meng after the villagers.
Dong, Dong, knocking on the door interrupted Dream Chaser's thoughts, and then the door was pushed open, and at the same time, the caring voices of the adoptive father and mother were heard.
What happened to Meng'er? Having nightmares again?
Zhui Meng looked around and saw a couple over fifty years old in front of him. The woman who spoke was the concerned woman.
As soon as he heard the word Meng'er, he knew that he was calling a girl. He was a good boy and was called Meng'er. Zhuimeng didn't respond for a while.
The couple did not notice anything wrong with Meng'er's expression at this time.
Zhui Meng calmed down and searched his mind for a while before he realized that he had traveled through time. During the process of traveling, he encountered an abnormal time-space reversal rule. His body became like a baby, and his memory was self-sealed. He had been raised by the couple in front of him for 12 years, Zhui Meng said quickly.
"No!
It's okay!
I’ll just sit on the bed for a while and it’ll be fine.”
Zhui Meng said, still a little uncomfortable, and then said with concern, "It's so late, adoptive parents, you are older, your health is important, go to bed early!"
"Is everything okay?"
The sound of "adoptive father and mother" made Zou Tieniu, the adoptive father who pursued his dream, have some doubts.
The couple's adoption of Zhui Meng was not hidden in the village, and Zhui Meng also knew about it.
Normally, Zhui Meng would call them father and mother directly, so he asked after seeing something unusual about Zhui Meng.
If it were the previous dream pursuit, he would definitely have talked with the two elders, telling him about the airplanes, cannons, and high-rise buildings in science he dreamed about, and about entering the great formation to gain cultivation inheritance.
But now Chai Meng will say with concern: "Really!
